findings.title: Keyspace-failure log level regressed from warn to debug
findings.claim: The removed code logged keyspace failures at warn!, but the new code logs at debug; since Broken is only published when the pool is empty, a partially filled pool with a dropped keyspace or permission problem silently stops growing with no operator signal.

findings.title: PR description omits the metrics-balance commits
findings.claim: Commits de164845 and 0d91aa54 change counter accounting in maybe_reshard and both excess-connection clears, and add three tests gated on --features metrics, but the PR description doesn't mention them and the listed validation command doesn't compile them.

findings.title: Fixes: #1682 annotation does not resolve
findings.claim: gh issue view 1682 fails in this repository, so the closing annotation is dead; it likely refers to upstream scylla-rust-driver.

findings.title: Timing-dependent test polls counter with sleeps instead of being deterministic
findings.claim: full_pool_clears_excess_connections_and_balances_metrics polls the counter with 1 ms sleeps under a 5 s timeout; awaiting pool_updated_notify or using start_paused = true like neighbouring tests would make it deterministic.

findings.title: decrement_total_connections loops fetch_sub(1) instead of a single atomic op
findings.claim: A single fetch_sub(n) helper would be simpler and atomic as a unit, instead of looping fetch_sub(1).
